messages:
mike: Quick sync  We keep seeing tail 503s when many tenants burst simultaneously. Root cause looks like packing failures + optimistic admission.
anya: Agreed. Two ideas: (1) make burst admission "frag-aware" (token carries packing_hint), (2) add a light-weight compaction budget to recover contiguous slots periodically.
lu: For tokens, prefer a compact signed voucher: tenant, credits, pref(contig/any), requested_slices, exp. Local agent verifies and CAS-decrements. Keeps admission O(1).
mike: How to allocate credits? baseline by tier + ephemeral earned credits with decay. But make earned credits require sustained activity (e.g., 3min) to avoid gaming.
anya: Compaction should be budgeted: run only if compaction_gain_estimate > cost_estimate * 1.8 and run during low-util windows. Emit metrics: fragmentation_ratio, compaction_gain_est, compaction_cost.
lu: Also add a quick fallback behavior: if contig pref fails and token allows fallback, try any-fit but tag request as "fallback_used" for telemetry. If no-fit, enqueue with SLA-derived max_wait or route to compatible variant.
mike: Security: short TTL tokens (<=1h) signed by operator via KMS endpoint. Rotate signing key frequently. Local agents verify signature only.
anya: Instrumentation: token_issued, token_consumed, token_fallback, token_double_spend_attempt, compaction_run. Surface in Console with tenant tags.
lu: Action items: Ill prototype voucher schema + CAS store; Anya will simulate earn-rate and decay; Mike will add console metrics + rollout plan. orch-bot: deploy:frag-aware-admit queued.
orch-bot: PR #6001 queued for canary.
mike: Thanks  quick follow-up tomorrow 9:30 to review simulation numbers.
